root_motivation: **Who:** an agent copying from llms.txt / host.help.search, and Joe reading the promise row of the digest. **What:** every tagged example in the docs runs, and the result it shows is the result the host returns. **Why not today:** scripts/gen-llms-full.sh only concatenates markdown; no test runs a docs fence, and only 6 recipes have proof scripts. **Consequence:** on 10-08 builders copied the mcphost.dev domain into an import from prose nothing had executed.
user_persona: A builder agent that copies a fenced call or tool spec from the docs and expects it to have been executed recently; a docs author who tags a fence and has CI refuse a failing example; Operator Joe reading the docs-examples count in the digest.

acceptance_criteria.description: Given the 109 fences of `www/llms-full.txt` at 4e07dfd, When `docs-examples classify` runs, Then it prints one line per fence with `runnable|fragment|prose` and ≥ 40 are `runnable`; a lower count fails the test and prints the fragment list.

Given a page with a `mcphost-tool kind=python name=t1` fence followed by a `mcphost-call expect=contains:hello` fence, When `extract` runs, Then the corpus has two entries in that order with ids `<path>#<heading>-1` and `-2`, and `--check` exits 0; after editing the fence body, `--check` exits 1 naming the id.

Given the corpus and the fixture host, When `run` executes, Then every entry prints `<id> pass <ms>` and the summary shows `examples_failed=0`; Given one fence changed to `expect=error:unknown_kind` on a passing call, Then that id prints `fail` with the actual code and the exit status is 1.
Given an example tagged `needs=anonymous`, When run, Then it is sent without a key; Given `skip=needs-secret`, Then it prints `skip` and is counted in `skipped`, not in `examples_failed`.
Given a `mcphost-call` whose tool was published by a fence on a different page, When `extract` runs, Then it exits 1 with `cross-page dependency <id> -> <id>`.

Given a stale corpus, When `scripts/gen-llms-full.sh` runs, Then it exits 1 before writing and names `docs/examples.corpus.json`; Given a fresh corpus and a `run --json` artifact, Then each tagged fence in `www/llms-full.txt` is followed by its `<!-- executed: … -->` comment.
Given the fixture host unreachable, When `run --url` is pointed at a closed port, Then it exits 2 with `host unreachable` after one retry and writes no artifact.

Given prod after deploy and the orch timer, When the first nightly run completes, Then `target/docs-examples/<date>.json` on orch shows `examples_failed: 0` and `examples_total` ≥ 40 (Live; evidence: `ssh orch 'ls -t ~/wintermute/mcphost/target/docs-examples/*.json | head -1 | xargs python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(open(sys.argv[1])); print(d[\"examples_total\"], d[\"examples_failed\"])"'`)
acceptance_criteria.test: deferred -- operator-provisioned: first nightly run of the orch timer against prod after deploy.

scope: src/docs_examples.rs (new): fence parser, classify, tag grammar, extract/corpus drift, cross-page check, run engine, artifact, annotate.
scripts/gen-llms-full.sh: corpus staleness gate + executed comments.
non_goals: Recipe sections (recipes/*.toml); generating examples from schemas; rewriting prose; the orch systemd timer (operator-provisioned).

additional.signup_is_not_remembered: R3 says signup or host.redeem, but tests/sessbind_* pin signup followed by key-less behavior; only host.redeem is recorded (AC4's own scenario).

five_whys_trace.q: Why did builders copy a wrong domain into an import?
five_whys_trace.a: The docs example was prose that nothing had executed.
gen-llms-full.sh concatenates markdown and the promise link checks names by string.

five_whys_trace.q: Why is there no executable form?
five_whys_trace.a: Fences carry no tag or expected response, so no tool can tell a call from a fragment.

ambiguities_resolved.question: Should expect=contains: match the full JSON or result.content[0].text only?
ambiguities_resolved.resolution: The text (content[0].text), falling back to the whole result when there is no text content.

ambiguities_resolved.question: The PRD says 109 fences; the file has 54.
ambiguities_resolved.resolution: 109 counts fence delimiter lines (108 at 4e07dfd); classify counts blocks and reaches 41 runnable.
